item.title: NXT rating for 12/16/2025
item.description: NXT had 607,000 viewers this week, down 40,000 viewers from the prior week. In 18-49, the show drew a 0.08 rating, down 0.01 from the last show. This week’s show was the last live broadcast of NXT for 2025 as the next two have been taped already.
